english.title: Exporter of dutiable goods where entry cancelled fail to furnish information and documents
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being an exporter where an entry in respect of

(A)_[dutiable]_
(B)_[restricted]_

goods, namely **(..SPECIFY THE GOODS..), was treated as cancelled by virtue of section 56 of the Customs and Excise Management Act 1979, failed within **(..SPECIFY THE TIME..), the period specified by directions given by the Commissioners, to furnish them with such information and such documents as specified in the directions
english.legislation: Contrary to section 56(3)(b) and (5) of the Customs and Excise Management Act 1979.
